Hi team,

We'd like to move forward with an offer to Michael Yang (candidate attached). Hiring manager (Maya) has requested Level: Sr. Inference Engineer.

Proposed comp structure (total target):

- Bonus: 15% target
- Equity: 0.35% over 4 years (standard refresh schedule)
- Sign-on: $25,000 (requested because of forfeited RSUs)

Attachments: candidate_resume_michael_yang.pdf, draft compensation_sheet.xlsx (pro forma with band comparisons).

Timing: candidate prefers a verbal offer this week and a DocuSign by EOD Mon 11/15 if possible.

- Ping me if you want the interview notes; panel scores are in the attached sheet.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15m if anyone wants to discuss.
